blocks.text: Gabrielle Galapia has given Filipinos more reason to cheer for her as she aims to give the Philippines its sixth Miss Asia Pacific International win. The Kapampangan lass amassed the most votes among members of the media attending the Press Presentation at Nustar Resort in Cebu City on Sept. 26 to receive the “Darling of the Press” award. “With her radiant presence, confidence, and undeniable charm, the Philippines captured the hearts of the members of the press,” the Miss Asia Pacific International pageant posted on social media.
